mutually--adv.def: In a way that affects two sides equally.

faction--noun.def: A small group inside a larger one with different views.
faction--noun.ex: A faction broke away from the party.

aesthetic--adj.def: Relating to beauty and the appreciation of it.

compel--verb.def: To force someone to do something.

conservatory--noun.def: A glass room attached to a house, or a music school.

ordinarily--adv.def: In the usual way, as a rule.

perceptive--adj.def: Quick to notice and understand things.

degrading--adj.def: Treating someone as if they have no dignity.
degrading--adj.ex: The work was degrading and badly paid.
degrading--adj.exTr: İş onur kırıcı ve kötü ücretliydi.

likelihood--noun.def: The chance that something will happen.
likelihood--noun.ex: There is little likelihood of snow.

invoice--noun.def: A document listing goods sold and the money owed.

sprout--verb.def: To begin to grow, said of a plant or a seed.
sprout--verb.ex: The seeds sprouted within a week.

sprout--noun.def: A new growth on a plant.

temperament--noun.def: A person's usual nature and way of reacting.

suitor--noun.def: A man who wants to marry a woman, in older usage.
suitor--noun.ex: Her father turned every suitor away.

waterfront--noun.def: The part of a town beside the sea or a river.

candid--adj.def: Honest and direct, even about difficult things.

robust--adj.def: Strong and able to survive difficult conditions.
robust--adj.ex: The design is simple and robust.

relapse--verb.def: To become ill again after getting better.

relapse--noun.def: A return of an illness after an improvement.

claustrophobic--adj.def: Afraid of small closed spaces, or feeling closed in.
claustrophobic--adj.exTr: Asansör onda kapalı yer korkusu yaratıyor.

rustle--verb.def: To make a soft dry sound like moving leaves.

rustle--noun.def: A soft dry sound of movement.
rustle--noun.ex: We heard a rustle in the grass.

recharge--verb.def: To fill a battery with power again, or to rest and recover.
recharge--verb.exTr: El fenerini gece boyunca şarj et.

unsettling--adj.def: Making you feel worried and uncomfortable.

lapse--noun.def: A small failure of memory or judgement, or a pause in time.
lapse--noun.ex: It was a lapse of concentration.

lapse--verb.def: To end because the time has run out, or to fall into a worse state.

rarity--noun.def: Something uncommon, or the state of being uncommon.

creamy--adj.ex: The soup has a creamy texture.

lavatory--noun.def: A toilet, in formal British English.
lavatory--noun.ex: The lavatory is on the left.

aqua--adj.def: Of a pale blue green colour.

continuity--noun.def: The state of continuing without a break.
continuity--noun.ex: The staff provide continuity of care.

scorn--noun.def: A feeling that someone deserves no respect.
scorn--noun.ex: She dismissed the idea with scorn.

staple--noun.def: A basic food that people eat often, or a small metal fastener.
staple--noun.ex: Rice is a staple in many countries.

prospective--adj.def: Likely to become something in the future.

crumb--noun.def: A very small piece of bread or cake.

limitless--adj.def: Having no end or no limit.

otter--noun.def: A river animal with thick fur that swims well.
otter--noun.ex: An otter slipped into the river.

elastic--noun.def: A material that stretches and returns to its shape.
elastic--noun.ex: The elastic in the waist has gone.

elastic--adj.def: Able to stretch and return to its original shape.

flashback--noun.def: A scene showing something that happened earlier.
flashback--noun.ex: The film opens with a flashback.

linear--adj.def: Going in a straight line, or in a simple order.

hypocritical--adj.def: Saying one thing while doing another.

unconventional--adj.def: Not following the usual way of doing things.

discard--verb.def: To throw something away because it is no longer wanted.

alignment--noun.def: The correct position in a line, or support for a side.
alignment--noun.ex: Check the alignment of the wheels.

silhouette--noun.def: The dark outline of something against a light background.
silhouette--noun.ex: The silhouette of the castle appeared.

collaborate--verb.def: To work together with someone on a project.
collaborate--verb.ex: Two universities collaborated on the study.
collaborate--verb.exTr: İki üniversite çalışmada iş birliği yaptı.

tantrum--noun.def: A sudden loud burst of anger, usually by a child.

genome--noun.def: The complete set of genes in a living thing.
genome--noun.exTr: Bilim insanları bütün genomun haritasını çıkardı.

compulsion--noun.def: A strong urge you cannot control, or being forced.
compulsion--noun.ex: He felt a compulsion to check twice.
compulsion--noun.exTr: İki kez kontrol etme dürtüsü hissetti.

dispense--verb.def: To give out something, especially medicine.

occupational--adj.ex: Back pain is an occupational risk here.
occupational--adj.exTr: Burada sırt ağrısı mesleki bir risk.

firewall--noun.def: A system that protects a computer network.

conserve--verb.def: To protect something, or to use it carefully.
conserve--verb.ex: We must conserve water in summer.

tract--noun.def: A large area of land, or a system of organs.
tract--noun.ex: A wide tract of forest burned.

spacious--adj.ex: The flat is bright and spacious.

conjure--verb.def: To make something appear as if by magic, or to bring to mind.
conjure--verb.ex: The smell conjured up his childhood.

premise--noun.def: A statement that an argument is built on.
premise--noun.ex: The whole plan rests on a false premise.
premise--noun.exTr: Bütün plan yanlış bir öncüle dayanıyor.

self-conscious--adj.def: Uncomfortably aware of how others see you.
self-conscious--adj.ex: He is self conscious about his accent.

sustainable--adj.def: Able to continue without harming the environment.

deprivation--noun.def: The state of not having what you need.

tycoon--noun.def: A very rich and powerful businessman.
tycoon--noun.ex: A shipping tycoon funded the hospital.
tycoon--noun.exTr: Hastaneyi bir denizcilik kodamanı finanse etti.

quirky--adj.def: Unusual in an interesting and pleasing way.
quirky--adj.ex: The shop has a quirky charm.
quirky--adj.exTr: Dükkânın kendine özgü bir cazibesi var.

quirky--noun.def: An odd but likeable feature of something.
quirky--noun.ex: Every old house has its quirky.
quirky--noun.exTr: Her eski evin bir tuhaflığı vardır.

fiercely--adv.def: In a strong and determined way.

implicate--verb.def: To show that someone was involved in something wrong.

exodus--noun.def: The departure of a large number of people at once.
exodus--noun.exTr: Kuraklık kırsaldan büyük bir göçe yol açtı.

revere--verb.def: To respect and admire someone very deeply.
revere--verb.exTr: Öğrenciler yaşlı profesöre derin saygı duyardı.

conscientious--adj.def: Careful to do work thoroughly and well.

overalls--noun.def: Loose clothing worn over other clothes to protect them.

insubordination--noun.def: Refusal to obey someone of higher rank.

nocturnal--adj.def: Active at night, said of animals.

tranquility--noun.ex: The tranquility of the valley surprised us.

exert--verb.def: To use power or influence, or to make a great effort.
exert--verb.ex: The moon exerts a pull on the sea.

chisel--verb.def: To cut wood or stone with a sharp metal tool.
chisel--verb.ex: He chiselled a name into the stone.

concerto--noun.def: A piece of music for one instrument and an orchestra.

align--verb.def: To put things in a straight line, or to support a side.
align--verb.ex: Align the edges before you glue them.
